title: From Uniform to Learned Knots: A Study of Spline-Based Numerical Encodings for Tabular Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2604.05635v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Numerical preprocessing remains a critical component of tabular deep learning, as the representation of continuous features can strongly affect downstream performance. We systematically study spline-based numerical encodings, including B-splines, M-splines, and integrated splines (I-splines), under uniform, quantile-based, target-aware, and learnable-knot placement. For the learnable variants, we adopt a differentiable knot parameterization that enables stable end-to-end optimization of knot locations jointly with the backbone. We evaluate these encodings on a diverse collection of public regression and classification datasets using MLP, ResNet, and FT-Transformer backbones, and compare them against common numerical preprocessing baselines. translated_title: 从均匀到学习结：基于样条的表格深度学习数值编码研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.05635v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：数值预处理仍然是表格深度学习的关键组成部分，因为连续特征的表示方式会显著影响下游性能。我们系统研究了基于样条的数值编码，包括B样条、M样条和积分样条（I样条），在均匀、分位数、目标感知和可学习结放置下的表现。对于可学习变体，我们采用了一种可微的结参数化方法，使得结位置能够与骨干网络一起进行稳定的端到端优化。我们在多种公开回归和分类数据集上，使用MLP、ResNet和FT-Transformer骨干网络评估了这些编码，并与常见的数值预处理基线进行了比较。我们的结果表明，数值编码的有效性强烈依赖于任务、编码大小和骨干网络。对于分类任务，分段线性编码（PLE）是最稳健的选择。
tldr: 本研究系统比较了多种样条数值编码方法，发现其性能高度依赖任务和模型结构，其中分段线性编码（PLE）在分类任务中表现最稳健。
en_tdlr: This study systematically compares various spline-based numerical encodings and finds their effectiveness highly depends on task and backbone, with piecewise-linear encoding (PLE) being the most robust choice for classification.
